MapGroupClusterFile.description: MapGroupClusterFile places cluster prototypes at world positions and can include additional cluster placement files.

group.description: Groups lists cluster prototype names and their world positions and rotations.

include.description: Includes references additional map group cluster files loaded with this file.

map.description: XMLName identifies the required `<map>` document root.

MapGroupInclude.description: MapGroupInclude identifies another map group cluster file to load.

file.description: File is the referenced file name without its `.xml` extension.

MapGroupInstance.description: MapGroupInstance places one prototype at a concrete map location in a map group file.

a.description: A is the instance's heading angle in degrees when the placement uses a single yaw value.

name.description: Name is the prototype or group identifier resolved by CE.

pos.description: Pos is the instance's world position as an X/Y/Z vector.

rpy.description: RPY is the instance's roll, pitch, and yaw rotation when the placement uses all three angles.
